title: 第9章 盗匪的反扑第10章 黑石镇的新生
lines: 太阳最后一点余光，也被镇子中心的石头房子给吞没了。
整个黑石镇一下子暗了下来。街巷里的影子堆在一起，越漫越长，像一张张黑乎乎的嘴，把最后那点暖和气儿都给吃掉了。风猛地变大了，卷着地上的血沫子和沙土，贴着巷子呼呼地乱窜。空气里那淡淡的血腥味被风一搅和，变得又浓又刺鼻，沉沉地压在胸口，让人喘气都费劲。
工坊那边传来密密麻麻的脚步声、家伙事的碰撞声，还有粗野的叫骂。三十多个盗匪全聚到一块儿了，他们不再散着巡逻，而是挤成一团，像一堵墙似的往这边压过来。人一多，那股子杀气就顺着巷子风直扑过来，根本不用细琢磨，光用眼睛看，就能感觉到他们这次是要玩命了，又凶又狠，什么都不顾了。
他们丢了一整支六人的巡逻队，没人回来报信，也没人逃掉，就这么静悄悄地没了。在这片盗匪横行的废土上，这不叫意外，这叫打脸。是那些被他们踩在脚底下半年的怂包，终于敢龇牙了，敢掀桌子了。
黑风寨的人，最拿手的就是用血来压服反抗，用杀人来抹掉不安分。
“所有人，收回来，退到巷子里埋伏好。”
陆寻的声音压得很低，却穿过大伙儿紧张的呼吸，清清楚楚地钻进每个人耳朵里。他站得笔直，左腿旧伤一阵阵地闷疼，每次挪重心都像有东西在里头扯，可他整个人稳得像块石头。
他从来不是靠膀大腰圆压倒对手的那种人。他的厉害，永远是在绝境里沉下来的那份算计和定力。
刚刚经历了头一回杀人的那十一个镇上小伙子，手上血还没干，身子还在微微发抖——不是怕，是头一回见血之后身体的自然反应。可没一个人往后缩，所有人立刻按之前商量好的，飞快地躲回两边阴影里，死死攥着手里的简陋家伙，眼睛一眨不眨地盯着巷子口。
他们眼里那点畏缩，这会儿全没了，只剩下憋了半年的恨和豁出去的决心。
苏野快步退回来，端着枪，侧身紧紧贴住墙，占住了巷子最前头的阻击位置。他双手稳稳握着猎枪，呼吸又长又匀，眨眼就进入了战斗状态，宽厚的背把后面一群年轻人都挡在了身后，扛起了最危险的正面对抗。
林小满站在队伍最里头，眉头紧锁，把精神感知全力铺开，像一张看不见的网，死死罩住正压过来的那群盗匪。她语速很快，但每个字都清楚，没半句废话：“盗匪主力三十四人，全都拿着家伙，有七把枪，集中在队伍前头。领头那个情绪特别狂暴，杀心最重，是黑风寨的头头。”
“他们队形很密，没分散试探，打算就这么正面硬推过来，强行扫平所有反抗的。估计八秒后进巷子口！”
情报一到位，局面就彻底清楚了。
对方人数是他们的两倍还多，有正经枪械，气势正凶，抱着踏平巷子、杀光所有人的心思扑过来。而他们呢，地形受限制，武器破旧，大多数人都是临时凑上的普通老百姓。唯一的优势，就是埋伏的先手，和拼死一战的决心。
硬碰硬，肯定完蛋。
只有借着这窄巷子，把对方人多的优势给废掉，在局部下死手，打乱他们的阵脚，才有一线活路。
陆寻目光飞快扫过这条狭窄的巷子，脑子急速推演着战斗。两边高墙夹出来的这条直道，是死胡同，却也是唯一的生路。对方人多，挤在一起往前冲确实有劲，可在这巷子里也转不开身，没法包抄，后面的人根本使不上劲，只能往前挤，活脱脱就是靶子。
“苏野，守住口子，只打前排拿枪的，压住他们的火力。”陆寻简短下令，每个字都钉在关键点上，“别贪多，开一枪把他们冲势打断就行。”
“所有人都听着，近身了也别躲，抱成团，别散！三人一组，专砍腿脚、攻下盘，撂倒了就补刀，千万别跟他们硬拼力气！”
“小满，等他们全进巷子，立刻用精神干扰，搅乱他们的脑子！”
命令一层层落下，所有人瞬间屏住呼吸，绷紧了身体，像一张张拉满了的弓。
下一秒，黑压压的盗匪像洪水一样冲进了巷子口。
打头的是个光着膀子的壮汉，身上横七竖八全是新旧伤疤，脖子上挂着一串发黑的兽牙，手里攥着一把改短的猎枪，眼睛瞪得血红，满脸都是暴戾的杀气。他就是黑风寨的头目，赵疤。
这半年来，他带着手下抢镇子、杀平民，早就习惯了镇上人麻木顺从的样子，从来没人敢反抗，更别说杀他的人了。
“哪个不要命的杂种，敢动老子的人？！”
赵疤的吼声震得巷子嗡嗡响，凶暴的声音裹着血腥气，“躲着不敢出来是吧？等老子把你们揪出来，剥了皮抽了筋，挂镇口让所有人瞧瞧！我倒要看看，黑石镇这群废物，什么时候长了反骨！”
脏话还没骂完，七把枪齐刷刷抬了起来，枪口对准幽深的巷子，黑洞洞的，泛着冷冰冰的光，死死瞄着前面的阴影。
只要一声令下，铁砂子弹就会泼水似的打出去，把藏着的人全撕碎。
“就是现在！”
陆寻低吼出声。
同一时间，林小满猛地凝神，把精神力量全部释放出去。
她的精神干扰没有什么爆炸性的杀伤力，伤不了人，也打不碎东西，却能精准地搅乱活物的感知神经，打散密集人群的判断力。一股无形的精神乱流瞬间卷过整条巷子，钻进了每个盗匪的脑袋里。
刹那间，冲在最前面的盗匪全懵了。
眼前发花、耳朵嗡嗡响、脚下像踩了棉花。有人眼前一黑，有人耳朵里只剩杂音，有人脚下一软差点摔倒。原本整齐往前冲的队伍，毫无预兆地卡住了，乱成一团，你挤我我推你。
举枪的人动作僵住了，扣扳机的手指不听使唤，瞄准的方向也歪了。
绝佳的机会，一闪就过。
苏野毫不犹豫，猎枪喷出火光。
轰！
近距离枪声炸响，铁砂精准地扫过前排两个枪手的手腕。骨头碎裂的脆响和惨叫同时爆开，那两个盗匪拿枪的手当场就废了，枪脱手飞出去，哐当砸在碎石地上。
唯一的远程火力，瞬间废了小一半。
陆寻不再隐藏，身形猛地窜了出去。他刻意不用左腿发力，靠着右腿爆发的劲儿，紧贴着墙快速前冲，短刀握在手里，寒光在昏暗的巷子里划出一道冷冽的弧线。
他不贪多，不冒进，专挑那些还晕乎着的盗匪下手。刀落得极准，每一刀都奔着脖子、咽喉、心口这些要命的地方去。废土上搏命的杀招，简单直接，没有半点花架子。
一个盗匪刚从精神混乱里挣扎出来，眼睛还没看清，喉咙就被冰冷的刀锋抵住了。
content_en:
The last remaining rays of the sun were swallowed up by the stone house in the center of the town.
The entire Blackstone Town suddenly darkened. The shadows in the streets piled up together, getting longer and longer, like black mouths, eating up the last bit of warmth. The wind suddenly became stronger, carrying the blood foam and sand on the ground, whistling along the alley. The faint smell of blood in the air was mixed by the wind and became thick and pungent. It pressed heavily on the chest, making it difficult to breathe.
From the other side of the workshop came the sound of dense footsteps, the sound of people clashing, and rude yelling. More than thirty bandits had all gathered together. They no longer patrolled in separate groups, but huddled together, pressing in like a wall. As soon as there were more people, the murderous aura rushed straight towards them along the wind in the alley. There was no need to think about it carefully. Just by looking at it, you could feel that they were going to risk their lives this time, they were fierce and ruthless, and they didn't care about anything.
They lost an entire patrol of six people. No one came back to report, and no one escaped. They just disappeared quietly. In this wasteland where bandits are rampant, this is not an accident, but a slap in the face. Those cowards who had been trampled under their feet for half a year finally dared to show their teeth and lift the table.
The people of Heifeng Village are best at subduing resistance with blood and erasing restlessness with murder.
"Everyone, take it back and retreat to the alley to ambush."
Lu Xun's voice was very low, but it passed through everyone's nervous breathing and penetrated into everyone's ears clearly. He stood upright, his left leg was aching from an old injury. Every time he shifted his weight, it felt like something was pulling inside, but his whole body was as stable as a rock.
He has never been the type to overwhelm his opponents with his big body and round waist. His strength is always his calculation and determination in desperate situations.
The eleven young men in the town who had just experienced their first murder had blood on their hands that was still trembling slightly, and their bodies were still shaking slightly - not because of fear, but because they were the body's natural reaction after seeing blood for the first time. But no one shrank back, everyone immediately followed the previously agreed plan and quickly hid in the shadows on both sides, holding the simple thing in their hands tightly and staring at the entrance of the alley without blinking.
The flinch in their eyes was gone now, leaving only the hatred they had held in for half a year and the determination to fight.
Su Ye quickly stepped back, holding the gun, leaning against the wall tightly, occupying the blocking position at the front of the alley. He held the shotgun firmly with both hands, breathed long and evenly, and entered combat mode in the blink of an eye. His broad back blocked the group of young people behind him, shouldering the most dangerous frontal confrontation.
Lin Xiaoman stood at the end of the team, frowning, spreading his mental awareness with all his strength, like an invisible net, tightly covering the group of bandits who were pressing over. She spoke very quickly, but every word was clear and there was no nonsense: "The main force of the bandits is thirty-four, all holding weapons and seven guns, concentrated at the front of the team. The leader is in a particularly violent mood and has the most murderous intentions. He is the leader of Black Wind Village."
"They formed a very dense formation and did not spread out their tests. They planned to push forward head-on and forcefully eliminate all those who resisted. They will probably enter the alley in eight seconds!"
Once the information was in place, the situation became completely clear.
The opponent's number was more than twice theirs. They had serious firearms and fierce momentum. They rushed towards them with the intention of flattening the alley and killing everyone. As for them, the terrain is restricted, the weapons are worn out, and most of them are ordinary people who make do. The only advantage is the ambush and determination to fight to the death.
If you go head-to-head, you'll definitely be doomed.
Only by taking advantage of this narrow alley to eliminate the opponent's advantage of having more people, and use local attacks to disrupt their position, can there be a way to survive.
Lu Xun's eyes quickly swept across the narrow alley, and his mind quickly deduced the battle. This straight road between high walls on both sides is a dead end, but it is also the only way to survive. There are many people on the other side, so it is really powerful to rush forward when crowded together, but in this alley, you can't turn around and can't outflank. The people behind you can't use their strength at all, so they can only push forward, and they are like targets.
"Su Ye, keep your mouth shut and only shoot those in the front row with guns to suppress their firepower." Lu Xun gave a brief order, focusing on key points in every word, "Don't be greedy, just shoot them with one shot to interrupt their momentum."
"Everyone, listen, don't hide when you get close, stay in a group and don't break up! Team up with three, specialize in cutting the legs and feet, attacking the lower body. If you're knocked down, just follow up. Don't compete with them!"
"Xiao Man, when they all enter the alley, use mental interference immediately to mess up their minds!"
The orders were issued one after another, and everyone held their breath for a moment and tensed their bodies, like a fully-stretched bow.
The next second, the black bandits rushed into the alley entrance like a flood.
The leader was a shirtless strong man with old and new scars all over his body. A string of blackened animal teeth hung around his neck. He held a shortened shotgun in his hand. His eyes were blood red and his face was full of violent murderous intent. He is the leader of Black Wind Village, Zhao Scar.
In the past six months, he has led his men to rob the town and kill civilians. He has long been accustomed to the numb and obedient appearance of the people in the town. No one has ever dared to resist, let alone the person who killed him.
"Which lifeless bastard dares to touch me?!"
Zhao Scar's roar made the alley buzz, and the ferocious voice was covered in the smell of blood, "You are hiding and you don't dare to come out, are you? Wait until I find you, skin and cramp your muscles, and hang them at the town gate for everyone to see! I want to see when these losers in Blackstone Town got backbones!"
Before the curse words were finished, seven guns were raised in unison, their muzzles pointed at the deep alley, which was dark and glowing with cold light, aiming at the shadows in front of them.
As long as you give an order, the iron-sand bullets will be sprayed out like water, tearing apart all the people hiding.
"Now!"
Lu Xun roared.
At the same time, Lin Xiaoman concentrated hard and released all his mental power.
Her mental interference has no explosive power. It cannot hurt people or break things, but it can accurately disrupt the sensory nerves of living creatures and disrupt the judgment of dense crowds. An invisible mental turbulence instantly swept through the entire alley and got into the heads of every robber.
In an instant, the bandits at the front were all stunned.
My eyes were blurry, my ears were buzzing, and my feet felt like cotton. Some people's vision went dark, some people heard only noise in their ears, and some people's feet softened and almost fell down. The team that was originally rushing forward in order got stuck without warning and became a mess. You squeezed me and I pushed you.
The man holding the gun froze, his finger on the trigger was not in control, and his aiming direction was also crooked.
The perfect opportunity passed by in a blink of an eye.
Su Ye didn't hesitate, and the shotgun sprayed out fire.
boom!
Gunshots rang out at close range, and iron sand accurately swept across the wrists of the two gunmen in the front row. There was a crisp sound of broken bones and screams at the same time. The hands of the two robbers holding the guns were useless on the spot. The guns flew out of their hands and hit the gravel ground with a clang.
The only long-range firepower was instantly destroyed by half.
"Up!"
Lu Xun stopped hiding and rushed out suddenly. He deliberately did not use his left leg to exert force, relying on the explosive energy of his right leg to rush forward quickly close to the wall. The short knife was held in his hand, and the cold light drew a cold arc in the dim alley.
He is neither greedy nor aggressive, and only picks out those bandits who are still dazed. The knife landed with great accuracy, and each knife was aimed at the neck, throat, and heart, which were the most critical places. The ultimate killing move in the wasteland is simple and direct, without any pretense.
A bandit just struggled out of his mental confusion. Before his eyes could see clearly, a cold blade was pressed against his throat.
title_en: Chapter 9 The Bandits’ Counterattack Chapter 10 The New Life of Blackstone Town
